title: Academic medical postgraduates: a competence iceberg model and measurement development
core_idea: Develop a maturity competence (iceberg) model and a measurement tool to define and prioritize the competencies academic medical postgraduate students need to become physician-scientists, using mixed qualitative and quantitative methods to generate and validate items.
tldr: Aim: construct a competence iceberg model and a validated instrument to clarify and assess the key competencies for academic medical postgraduates, informing training priorities through mixed-methods development and validation.
